#{pullMonth}
(SELECT MAX(x.pull_month) FROM amz_fba_inventory_monthly_snapshot x)
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{warehouseName}, '%')
AND CAST(sid AS CHAR) = #{sid}
AND ( sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR fnsku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR asin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT pull_month, COUNT(*) AS sku_count, COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS total_inventory, COALESCE(SUM(available_total), 0) AS available_inventory, COALESCE(SUM(inv_age_181_to_270_days), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(inv_age_271_to_365_days), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(inv_age_365_plus_days), 0) AS slow_inventory_180_plus, COALESCE(SUM(inv_age_365_plus_days), 0) AS slow_inventory_365_plus, COALESCE(SUM(estimated_excess_quantity), 0) AS estimated_excess_quantity, MAX(pulled_at) AS pulled_at FROM amz_fba_inventory_monthly_snapshot WHERE pull_month =
#{pullMonth}
(SELECT MAX(x.pull_month) FROM amz_fba_inventory_monthly_snapshot x)
GROUP BY pull_month
